notes: The browser hour is almost free and the traffic is not. A crawl that pulls 1 GB through the consumer-connection proxy costs 250 browser hours at this rate, so the proxy is the bill.

extras.price_basis: 300 and 730 BROWSER HOURS, not a 2 vCPU shape. A browser host sells minutes of a remote browser, so these rows are not comparable with a sandbox row.

binding_note: the one-time credit is the clock; the 15-minute session cap is the second constraint
